newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine army helicopter crashes, several dead.
newsitem.headline: Argentine army helicopter crashes, several dead.

text.p: An Argentine army helicopter crashed in a Buenos Aires polo ground on Tuesday and the Interior Ministry said several people were killed.
Interior Minister Carlos Corach told the state-owned Telam news agency that there were several dead, without specifying how many.

Television images showed fire fighters combatting flames engulfing a mass of unrecognizable wreckage on the green grass of the Argentine Polo Grounds in the suburb of Palermo. The aircraft's twisted tail lay nearby.

An eyewitness told local television how an injured man ran enveloped in flames from the wreckage: "They shouted 'Get out! Get out! Get out!' And they were waiting for him with a fire extinguisher, and they put him out."
He said the helicopter had been coming in to land when it flipped over and crashed. Witnesses said they had seen six or seven people flee the wreckage.
